definitions: A verbal mistake that is thought to reveal an unconscious belief, thought, or emotion.
An unintentional error in speech or action that is presumed to be caused by a repressed wish or idea.
examples: He meant to say 'dear' but said 'dead'—a real Freudian slip.
Her Freudian slip about wanting to be on vacation instead of at work was quite telling.
The speaker's Freudian slip revealed his true feelings about the policy.
